findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V184 views and six pose renders still shows pronounced folds/facets in the overskirt. Crouch lifts the skirt above the fitted shorts and exposes the thighs across the front; sit bunches the skirt behind the pelvis while the shorts and upper thighs remain broadly exposed. This prototype has not resolved pose coverage or drape and is not fit acceptance.

The V184 front and neutral renders show fewer broad gray chest patches than V183 after the declared front-panel clearance increase, but a distinct gray rectangular patch remains at the right waist and rough planar facets remain across the torso and side views. Its cause is still unverified; visible bodice quality remains unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep V184 rejected. The 8 mm front bodice placement reduced some visible chest patches but the right-waist patch and torso facets remain. Inspect the actual right-waist garment/body surface relation and topology around this localized region before another bodice change. Treat crouch/sit skirt exposure and bunching as a separate blocker; preserve fit, bone/weight, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates.
